description: Debug, inspect, test, and optimize web applications through the Chrome DevTools MCP server and CLI.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use Chrome DevTools to inspect this web page, reproduce the issue, gather evidence from the DOM, console and network, then recommend or implement a minimal verified fix.
interface.longDescription: Use Chrome DevTools MCP to inspect live browser pages, automate reliable interactions, diagnose console and network failures, audit accessibility, analyze performance traces, and investigate memory issues. Requires Node.js and a supported Chrome installation or a configured running Chrome instance.

name: chrome-devtools-agent
